hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.ts) npx eslint --fix "$f" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */src/migrations/*.ts) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Migrations are generated via the TypeORM CLI, not hand-edited. Confirm this edit was explicitly requested before proceeding."}}' ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | { read -r c; if echo "$c" | grep -qE 'git +push[^|;&]*--force|git +commit[^|;&]*--amend'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Force-push and amend are blocked by project policy (see repo-publisher.md). Tell the user directly if this is genuinely needed."}}'; fi; }

hooks.statusMessage: Verifying build and tests before push...
hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | { read -r c; case "$c" in *"git push"*) if npm run build >/tmp/qa-verify.log 2>&1 && npx jest --passWithNoTests >>/tmp/qa-verify.log 2>&1; then :; else echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Build or test failed before push — see /tmp/qa-verify.log. Fix before pushing."}}'; fi ;; esac; }
